newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia drags Helsinki but tone solid, volume high.
newsitem.headline: Nokia drags Helsinki but tone solid, volume high.

text.p: Shares fell in hefty trade on Thursday, ending a record-pushing straight as profit-takers fed on Wednesday's sharp gains in Nokia after overnight weakness in Wall St and a large stock sale by UPM, brokers said.
The FOX stock futures index fell 0.33 percent to 1,098.85, while the all-share HEX dropped 0.5 percent to 3,209.90 points.
But volume rose to over 900 million markka, and brokers said the underlying tone remained bullish.
"Foreign demand remains high, and Finnish investors will be back from holiday in a matter of weeks," one broker said.
Nokia closed at 388.00 markka, down 5.00 in hefty trade.
UPM-Kymmene gained 0.50 markka to end at 123.40 in heavy 97 million markka volume.

Interest was boosted after UPM said on Wednesday evening it had sold 4.5 million of its Nokia shares for a 1.5 billion markka gain, which would help its balance sheet -- analysts said that improved prospects for financing an acquisition abroad.
Raisio had another volatile session, ending down 21.00 markka at 357.00 in lively 37 million markka dealings. "A big U.S. investor has been selling today," one broker said.
Brokers said some investors were tiring of waiting for Raisio to find a partner to launch its Benecol margarine abroad.
